prompt: /fill-the-gaps I deleted retry.py, it was only used here and I don't want a module for it. Fix client.py and write fetch_team (GET https://api.example.com/teams/{team_id}/members, same retries).
message:
Done. Both locks are at default `y`, so no new definitions or renames — I inlined the retry logic instead of restoring a decorator module.

- Deleted the `from retry import retry_on_error` import and the `@retry_on_error(3)` call — the module is gone for good, as you intended. Its work is now done by a plain `for attempt in range(3)` loop with `try/except OSError` and `time.sleep(2**attempt)`, duplicated in both functions using only builtins (`range`, `time.sleep`).
- `fetch_user` keeps identical behavior (3 attempts, exponential backoff on `OSError`).
- `fetch_team` is implemented with the same retry pattern, hitting `GET https://api.example.com/teams/{team_id}/members`.

+        try:

+        except OSError:
